heading: How to effectively display multiple packages for the samebuilding or unit in the task list?

blocks.html: Addressing the complex housing layout in Japan identified in our research, we face the challenge of informing drivers accurately about multiple packages for the same building or unit. To tackle this issue, it is not just about designing the information hierarchy of one single card, but also about how to better organize these cards by the recipient’s address to help drivers manage their task lists more easily.
